title: Settle definitively unsupported named-root operations without a pending intent
outcome: Settle definitively unsupported named-root operations without a pending intent
acceptance: Settle definitively unsupported named-root operations without a pending intent is done
disposal_reason:
Moot (Termal::Fable2, TermAl coordinator, 2026-10-15 20:28Z).
- Engram has no authoritative "operation unsupported by this build" code or capability contract on the host protocol. An unknown operation fails frame parsing as `invalid_request`, the same code as any malformed or oversized frame (Engram::Fable, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #2177). So no definitive signal exists, and TermAl correctly does not infer one: engram_named_root_binding.rs:1652 treats only named_root_binding_refused as definitive.
- Every pinned Engram build supports named_root_bind, so the trigger is reachable only on an obsolete build.
- If a definitive signal is ever needed, file an Engram contract item for a dedicated code, as Engram::Fable offered.
Triage: Termal::Opus3, TermAl mailbox 03723eab #2619.
